title: Koala dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- dance floor glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='35' ry='6' fill='#1a2a3a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='28' ry='4' fill='#2a4a6a'/>
  
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='20' ry='22' fill='#8a9aab'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='14' ry='16' fill='#b0c0d0'/>
  
  <!-- left arm raised in dance -->
  <path d='M32 58 Q20 42 14 30' stroke='#8a9aab' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <circle cx='13' cy='28' r='5' fill='#8a9aab'/>
  
  <!-- right arm raised -->
  <path d='M68 58 Q80 42 86 30' stroke='#8a9aab' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <circle cx='87' cy='28' r='5' fill='#8a9aab'/>
  
  <!-- left leg kicking -->
  <path d='M42 86 Q36 94 28 96' stroke='#8a9aab' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='96' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#6a7a8b'/>
  
  <!-- right leg -->
  <path d='M58 86 Q64 94 72 96' stroke='#8a9aab' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='96' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#6a7a8b'/>
  
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='20' fill='#8a9aab'/>
  
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='22' r='11' fill='#8a9aab'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='22' r='7' fill='#c0d0e0'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='22' r='11' fill='#8a9aab'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='22' r='7' fill='#c0d0e0'/>
  
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='14' ry='12' fill='#d0dce8'/>
  
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='37' r='3.5' fill='#1a1a2a'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='37' r='3.5' fill='#1a1a2a'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='36' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='36' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#3a3a4a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='43.5' rx='2' ry='1.5' fill='#5a5a6a'/>
  
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 50 Q50 55 56 50' stroke='#4a5a6a' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- tuft of fur on head -->
  <path d='M50 18 Q48 10 53 12 Q56 8 55 16' fill='#8a9aab'/>
  
  <!-- music notes -->
  <g fill='#ffcc44'>
    <circle cx='16' cy='14' r='2.5'/>
    <rect x='18' y='4' width='1.8' height='10' fill='#ffcc44'/>
    <path d='M19.8 4 Q24 3 24 7' stroke='#ffcc44' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#ff88aa'>
    <circle cx='82' cy='10' r='2.5'/>
    <rect x='84' y='0' width='1.8' height='10' fill='#ff88aa'/>
    <path d='M85.8 0 Q90 -1 90 3' stroke='#ff88aa' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none'/>
  </g>
</svg>
